name: Adapted Coordinate Texture (ACT) Module
definition: A module that transforms 3D texture coordinates provided by a Volume Rendering (DVR) technique into 2D texture coordinates and color channels, allowing 3D volume data stored in 2D texture arrays to be accessed with trilinear interpolation on hardware that only supports 2D textures.
summary: The Adapted Coordinate Texture module maps 3D volume data to 2D textures, allowing Direct Volume Rendering to remain independent of the underlying storage layout.
